choice.basis: The dashboard trend is assessed over the 2018-2023 window. The Capacity Index starts at approximately 2,800 in 2018 and ends at approximately 2,500 in 2023. Comparing the endpoints of the review window shows a net decrease in capacity. The title 'Increasing River Restoration Capacity' is refuted by the plotted data. A net decline over the full review window maps to the decline response route.
choice.option_label: Route the record to restoration capacity decline response review
